ayat.text: Indeed, the first house of worship established for mankind was that at Makkah—blessed and a guidance for the worlds. In it are clear signs such as the standing place of Ibrahim...
رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيُّ الْعِلِيمِ
Have We not established for them a safe sanctuary to which are brought the fruits of all things as provision from Us?

hadith.expanded_reference: Sahih Muslim, Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer, Chapter: The Masajid Built on Earth and Which Was First, Hadith 520
hadith.text: Rasulullah was asked about the masjid which was first set up on the earth. He responded: It was Al-Masjid al-Haram, then Al-Masjid al-Aqsa

hadith.expanded_reference: Sunan Ibn Majah, Book of Marriage, Chapter: The Virtue of Marriage / Hajj and Umrah Virtues, Hadith 2898
hadith.text: Perform Hajj and Umrah one after the other, for performing them one after the other removes poverty and sin as the bellows removes impurity from iron

hadith.expanded_reference: Sahih Muslim, Book of Pilgrimage, Chapter: The Obligation of Hajj Once in a Lifetime, Hadith 1337
hadith.text: O people, Allah has made Hajj an obligation for you, so perform Hajj

hadith.expanded_reference: Sahih Muslim, Book of Pilgrimage, Chapter: The Virtue of Hajj and Umrah, Hadith 1348
hadith.text: Jihad of the elderly, the young, the weak, and woman is Hajj and Umrah

dua.text: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيُّ الْعِلِيمِ

topics.name: Historical Origins of Hajj
topics.description: The establishment of Baitullah by angels at the time of Adam A.S. and its reconstruction by Ibrahim and Ismail.

topics.name: Sanctity and Virtues of Makkah
topics.description: The sacred status of Makkah as Al-Balad al-Amin, its blessings, security, and the multiplication of rewards for worship.

topics.name: Obligation of Hajj (Fardiyyat al-Hajj)
topics.description: The divine command obligating Hajj once in a lifetime for those with physical and financial capacity (istita'ah).

topics.name: Excellence and Rewards of Pilgrimage
topics.description: The spiritual superiority of Hajj, expiation of sins, wiping out poverty, and being counted among Allah's delegations.
